author: Jamie Kim
subject: Zenara - restaurant edge + network refresh
body:
Attendees: Tamara Bryant (CIO), Erin Foster (Dir IT), Karen Green (Network Eng); Orvane: Jamie Kim, Hao Stewart, Nathan Nakamura

- ~140 restaurant locations + 2 commissaries + HQ in Overland Park. Each site: POS, kitchen display, back-office Cadence SFF, guest Wi-Fi.
- Edge/IoT: walk-in cooler sensors and fryer telemetry, today on consumer-grade gear. Want Mesh SD-WAN edge per site plus Mesh PoE switching, central management.
- DC: vSphere 7 in a colo, Google Cloud for loyalty app + analytics. Backup software is a third-party package on generic disk.
- Procurement: Zenara AP is slow - Tamara warned us "we pay, but we pay late." Net 30 terms on our side.

Actions: Hao - per-site Mesh BOM (SD-WAN Edge 300 + 24-port PoE); Nathan - edge reference design; Jamie - check credit line size with credit dept before we quote 140 sites.

author: Jamie Kim
subject: SO-30217345 short-pay
body: SO-30217345 ($88,448, PO-2022-0630) - AP paid the invoice short by ~$3.1K, citing "quoted price." The quote had expired and we re-priced before booking; Lisa Tran had signed off on the new number. First time I've seen them short-pay; flagging for whoever has this next.

author: Dominic Moore
subject: Zenara AP aging
body: fyi Zenara invoices averaging ~70 days to pay on Net 30. Credit dept says normal for restaurant groups but their line is small, so any order >$75K will likely hold. Also they're reusing PO-2022-0630 across orders (Ashley's SO-30217374 went on it too). Plan accordingly.

author: Min-jun Cook
subject: SO-30217432 booked - credit hold
body: SO-30217432 ($128,254, PO-2023-0932) - Emily's Atlas hosts + Cadence for 9 new locations - went straight to Credit Limit Exceeded. Released after AP paid two invoices. Approved 38% discount on the Cadence lines to beat Varenta on the bid - approval email from my manager, not in deal desk (deal desk system was down). Customer now expects 38% as the standard. Need to document this somewhere.

author: Carly Vaughn
subject: Takeover - Zenara Co.
body:
New AO 10/20, inherited from Min-jun Cook with an 11-day gap. No handoff call.
What I found:
- Recurring AP issues: late pays, at least one short-pay in 2022, order holds for credit. Lindsey's Strata order SO-30217475 ($128,004) went on credit hold the week before I started.
- Discounts: some Cadence orders at 38%, others at 32%. No deal desk record of the 38% approvals. Customer thinks 38% is their contract rate - there is no contract.
- Competitor: Varenta on client devices, aggressive.
- Contacts: Nathan Reddy (CIO) primary, Laura Okafor (Dir IT Procurement) runs POs, Robert Lopez (AP Mgr) for invoices.
To do: get a pricing agreement in writing so AP stops disputing.

author: Carly Vaughn
subject: Invoice dispute - SO-30217499
body:
Hi Carly,

We've paid invoice for SO-30217499 at $56,169 instead of $61,605. The difference reflects the 38% discount Zenara has received on prior Cadence purchases. Please issue a credit memo for the balance or a corrected invoice.

For reference, this was ordered against PO-2023-0932.

Thank you,
Chloe Simmons
AP Specialist | Zenara Co.

---
[Carly reply 2/21: quoted price was 32% per the quote on file; 38% was a one-time approval in 2023. Asked deal desk to review. Note PO-2023-0932 is the same PO as last April's SO-30217432 - they never closed it.]

author: Carly Vaughn
subject: Aster 5 x50 won - clean order for once
body: Closed won 0065f00004fSccSAAS Aster 5 x50 ($153,824). SO-30217576 ($166,130, PO-2024-1162) went through with no hold - first one in a year, because AP paid down AR in September. Credit dept told me Zenara's line is $350K and open AR was ~$210K before this order. The 2024 SO-30217499 short-pay balance is still open.

author: Hao Stewart
subject: Same PO on everything
body: SO-30217631 ($12,411) - Mesh SD-WAN Edge 300 units for new restaurants - booked on PO-2025-8734. That PO number is on almost every Zenara order this year. Last month SO-30217611 ($20,561) sat on credit hold for a twenty-thousand-dollar order before credit released it. @Carly Vaughn can we get a standing fix?

author: Lindsey Holt
subject: SO-30217650 - no PO
body: SO-30217650 ($148,340) - Strata 300 G4 (N2FD9BV) for the ERP data tier - booked with no PO at all; Laura said it's coming. No hold this time, but AP will reject the invoice without a PO reference, which means another past-due. The other G4 (3S5NRZ2) is already ~83% - they'll need more soon.

author: Megan Martin
subject: Atlas refresh scoping - ERP + New York DC
body:
Attendees: Joshua Kowalski (Dir Infra), Thomas Choi (Dir Infra), Travis Park (DC Ops), Brandon Sato (Storage Admin); Orvane: Megan Martin (SA), Alicia Watson, Carly Vaughn

Context: ERP migration (cloud ERP + on-prem integration tier) is the driver; cutover planned for January. New York distribution center opened this month and needs local compute.

Scope
- Joshua's original ask: ~30 Atlas hosts across colo + NY. Varenta quoting the same.
- Budget reality per Joshua: likely closer to 19 nodes (Atlas 140, 1-socket) in this FY, rest next year.
- AI production: menu demand forecasting moving on-prem from GCP - 2 GPU nodes (48GB class) priced as a separate line.
- vSphere 7 -> 8 upgrade with the new hosts; VMware licensing under per-core subscription - 1-socket nodes help.
- Storage: N2FD9BV takes the ERP tier; Lindsey to look at 3S5NRZ2 capacity.

Decisions: Alicia to quote both 30-node and 19-node versions; target close before ERP cutover.
Actions: Alicia - quotes by 9/10; Megan - rack elevation + VLAN plan (mgmt 110, vMotion 120, storage 130); Carly - check credit line headroom BEFORE we close (lesson learned).

author: Alicia Watson
subject: 0065f00004fTAdoAAG closed won - no order
body:
Carly moved 0065f00004fTAdoAAG ($969,080, the 30-node version) to Closed Won on 11/17 off Joshua's verbal so it lands in the quarter. There is no order and no PO - Laura says nothing gets cut until after the ERP freeze. If they go with 19 nodes this needs to be re-scoped, not left as a won opp with no order.
Meanwhile SO-30217682 ($73,874, rails + ProCare for the existing hosts) sat on Awaiting PO for two weeks - "cust AP slow."

author: Carly Vaughn
subject: RE: Past due statement - Zenara Co.
body:
Carly,

Responding to the statement your collections team sent. Our position:
1. Invoices for SO-30217642 and SO-30217661 were paid at the discount on our approved POs. The balance (~$5.8K combined) is disputed and will not be paid until we receive credit memos.
2. Invoices for SO-30217675 are in approval. Our ERP migration freezes new vendor payments and new POs from Dec 15 until cutover (planned Jan 20).
3. Please route all future invoices to ap@zenara.com, not to individual staff.

Regards,
Robert Lopez
Accounts Payable Manager
Zenara Co.

> From: Orvane Collections
> Total past due: see attached. Account is approaching credit limit; new orders may be held.

author: Carly Vaughn
subject: Aster 7 x70 - verbal + PO timing
body:
Laura Okafor (Dir IT Procurement) gave verbal on Aster 7 x70 ($183,065) for district managers + the New York DC office. Can't cut a PO - ERP freeze started 12/15, new system go-live 1/20. She'll send a PO number from the new system "first week after cutover."
Booked SO-30217694 ($194,964) to close the quarter, using PO-2025-8734 as reference (their 2025 blanket - Laura said OK verbally, it's closed in their old system). Order is On Hold - Awaiting PO. Credit says it would hold anyway once the PO arrives - AR over limit.
Also told Laura the Atlas 140 deal (Alicia) and the NY DC portal order will hit the same wall. She knows.

body:

- Current: SO-30217675

author: Brooke Davis
subject: OFS option for Atlas 140
body: Looked at moving SO-30217706 (Atlas 140 x19, $744,115) to Orvane Financial Services FMV lease so it comes off the trade credit line. OFS credit says they'd approve, but internal policy won't book a new lease while the customer has 60+ day past-due on trade AR. Dead end until AP pays. Will revisit after cutover.

author: Jordan Morris
subject: Internal - Zenara credit hold / deal desk
body:
Attendees (internal): Carly Vaughn, Jordan Morris (TAM, started 12/28), Gavin Sato, Brooke Davis, Alicia Watson, credit dept rep, deal desk

Orders on hold
- SO-30217694 $194,964 Aster 7 x70 - Awaiting PO, ref PO-2025-8734 (placeholder)
- SO-30217706 $744,115 Atlas 140 x19 - Awaiting PO, same placeholder
- Total on hold: $939,079. Plus NY DC portal order (~$100K) Carly expects to book next week.

Credit position (per credit rep)
- Credit line $400K (Carly's 2024 note said $350K - credit says it was raised in March 2025). Open AR ~$395K, ~$140K of it 60+ days.
- Even with POs in hand, credit will not release ~$940K against a $400K line. Needs paydown + temporary limit increase, or OFS once past-due clears.
- Short-pays: ~$5.8K disputed on two invoices + the 2024 SO-30217499 balance (~$5.4K) never resolved.

Root causes: undocumented 38% discount precedent from 2023; Zenara ERP freeze; PO-2025-8734 used as a catch-all; small credit line for account size.
Also: 0065f00004fTAdoAAG ($969,080) is Closed Won with no order - deal desk wants it re-scoped or closed.

Decisions
- Deal desk to issue one-time credit memos on disputed short-pays IF Zenara signs a pricing letter confirming 32% standard going forward.
- No releases until 60+ day AR paid. No exceptions approved.

Actions: Carly - pricing letter to Laura Okafor; Gavin - weekly AR call with Robert Lopez; Jordan - align delivery dates once released; Brooke - re-run OFS after paydown.

Carly Vaughn
Account Executive | Orvane Technologies

author: Carly Vaughn
subject: Zenara - status after ERP cutover slip
body:
ERP cutover slipped from 1/20 to 2/2. No POs until then.
NY DC order went in via Premier Portal 1/19 - SO-30217721 ($101,351, Mesh SD-WAN Edge + Aster for the DC office) - straight to Credit Limit Exceeded hold, open AR over limit. Portal defaulted the PO field to PO-2025-8734 again.
Three orders now on hold: SO-30217694, SO-30217706 (Awaiting PO) + SO-30217721 (credit). ~$1.04M total.
Robert Lopez says the 60+ day items get paid in the first run on the new system. Laura has the pricing letter, "reviewing with legal."
Forecast: 0065f00004fT8GLAA0 ($177,568, close 2/23) and Alicia's 0065f00004fT6XxAAK ($1,026,860) both at Proposal - not committing either until credit is clean. Varenta is quoting both.
